chapter: Early band, Emmett Hardy and Werlein's
title: Oscar Marcour, Joe Lorcanna and Alonzo Crumby in his band
summary: He recalls violinist Oscar Marcour, trombonist/bassist Joe Lorcanna, and drummer Alonzo Crumby, whose steady tempo and band-first attitude he praises.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
